camera.eye_source: open bow deck of a Molinari/Barberi-class Staten Island Ferry: upper (promenade) deck about 6.4 m above the waterline, plus 1.6 m eye height; the boat is not modelled, so the camera floats free at that height over the Upper Bay
camera.ground_source: the viewpoint note names the raised surface the photographer stood on, so the heightmap height at the point itself is the ground (the neighbourhood is still measured and printed, because a terrace can stand metres above the plaza 4 m away and a median across that step would put the camera underground)

camera_caption: camera 40.69100, -74.02150 (NYC_TM -6044, -997) z 8.0 m NAVD88 | azimuth 15.8deg pitch +0.0deg | 28 mm on 36 mm (65.5deg horizontal) | 1280x560

camera_origin.source: the item's recorded viewpoint; this photograph's own EXIF GPS is 699 m away, past the 250 m at which it could still be the same view, so the camera was not stood on it.  That is a statement about this pairing and not about the photograph: a fix this far out is usually correct and simply of somewhere else

clearance.note: the viewpoint is in open air on the ground and the camera was not moved; nothing built stands within 60 m of the lens, and no simulated agent stands within 60 m of it, and the view azimuth is clear for 150 m

lens_reason: ferry-deck skyline, same wide framing as the promenade

emissive.note: daylight frame: the modelled light-cone faces are deleted (their alpha is texture-linked, so making the material transparent does not work) and street-lamp lenses switched off (dusk-to-dawn control); signals and shopfront emissives left on

name: Staten Island Ferry deck view of Lower Manhattan
pitch_reason: level optical axis (the subject is 2510 m away; anything that far is photographed with a level camera)

resolution_note: 1280x560; the reference photograph is 1920x840 (2.29:1), and the render is held to the same pixel budget as a 1280 px landscape frame

agents.caption: Agents: 50 vehicles within 150 m and 7 people within 120 m, from one frame of the traffic and pedestrian simulations, seed 20260907, after 120 s of simulated time; the density table asks for 217 vehicles and 208 people over the whole simulated ring, of which 228 and 226 were simulated; 397 dropped (see render.json).  This is the simulation's own traffic and crowd for that hour and neighbourhood, not the people and vehicles in the photograph.

snapshot.produced_by: blender/verify/agent_snapshot.cpp — nycsim_gameplay::TrafficSim and nycsim_gameplay::PedSim (unreal/NYCSim/Source/NYCSimRuntime/Private/CoreAdapter), the same simulations the Unreal traffic subsystem steps, over the shipped road graph
snapshot.protected_region: disabled (radius 0, no cone): the gameplay rule that stops agents appearing in view of a moving player would otherwise leave the whole foreground empty of spawns, and a still frame has no player
snapshot.records: VehicleSnapshot / PedSnapshot, the structs UNYCTrafficSubsystem reads from FNYCSimSnapshot
